observation_ref.description: Optional successful document.inspect/v1 or per-entry document.list/v1 Evidence from this Run; fixes acquisition to the observed document and storage version. Invalid or missing evidence fails without ordinary-read fallback.

publish_artifact.description: Explicitly persist the exact converted UTF-8 Markdown as an immutable Run Artifact for later approved document.write. Uses existing Artifact quotas; no workspace or MinIO write. Default conversion behavior remains unchanged.
